intended_use: Private, single-user research interface; not an authoritative point-in-time research archive or investment signal service.
delivery: Local Docker Compose or local Node process. The public source/build does not provide a hosted data service.

sources.name: Google News RSS
sources.identity: Article URL and feed-provided GUID when available; matched to configured company.
sources.time: RSS pubDate is used when valid; missing or invalid pubDate currently falls back to local retrieval time.
sources.retention: Normalized mention fields are stored in SQLite; raw feed bodies and response digests are not retained.
sources.rights: Provider terms and downstream redistribution rights have not been reviewed for this project.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance RSS and chart endpoint
sources.identity: Configured ticker for quotes and chart series; article URL for RSS items.
sources.units: Quote price in provider currency; percent change relative to provider previous close.
sources.time: Quote uses regularMarketTime when present and currently falls back to retrieval time; collected history is also timestamped at local polling time.
sources.retention: Normalized quote and price points are stored in SQLite; raw responses and response digests are not retained.
sources.rights: Provider terms, retention, and redistribution rights have not been reviewed for this project.

sources.name: GDELT DOC 2.0
sources.identity: Article URL and domain, matched to configured company.
sources.time: Provider seendate is retained as seenAt when parseable; the adapter currently falls back to local retrieval time when absent or invalid.
sources.retention: Normalized mention fields are stored in SQLite; raw responses and response digests are not retained.
sources.rights: Provider terms and downstream redistribution rights have not been reviewed for this project.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR submissions and filing documents
sources.identity: CIK, accession number, form type, and filing items.
sources.time: Filing date and acceptanceDateTime are kept separately when supplied by the SEC.
sources.retention: Normalized filing metadata and bounded extracted text are stored with mentions; raw response bodies and response digests are not retained.
sources.rights: Official public endpoints are used; project-specific retention and redistribution policy has not been reviewed.

sources.name: Finnhub company news, earnings, and calendar
sources.identity: Provider symbol, article URL, and earnings period when supplied.
sources.time: News datetime and earnings date are taken from provider responses.
sources.retention: Optional source enabled only with the operator's FINNHUB_API_KEY; normalized fields only.
sources.rights: Operator must supply credentials and follow provider terms; project-specific storage limits have not been reviewed.

sources.name: X API recent search
sources.identity: Provider post ID and configured ticker/company match.
sources.retention: Optional source enabled only with the operator's X_BEARER_TOKEN; normalized fields only.
sources.rights: Operator must supply credentials and follow provider terms; project-specific storage limits have not been reviewed.

sources.name: Reddit search
sources.identity: Provider post ID and configured company match.
sources.retention: Optional source enabled only with the operator's Reddit app credentials; normalized fields only.
sources.rights: Operator must supply credentials and follow provider terms; project-specific storage limits have not been reviewed.

fixture.covers: Offline parsing and scoring fixtures, including RSS and SEC filing examples.

failure.covers: Malformed or empty RSS inputs, filtered SEC records, and missing or unusable earnings values. Does not cover provider timeout, rate-limit recovery, or identity conflicts end to end.

replay.covers: Recreates a container over a retained SQLite volume. This is process recovery, not replay from retained raw provider responses.
replay.blocker: No usable Docker daemon: the selected Citrini context belongs to a separate build, and the generic default Colima profile could not start because its saved disk configuration requires an unsupported shrink; see the dated project log.

live_smoke.covers: Credential-free live quote and news/filing source success through the HTTP API, with DEMO and Jev scoring disabled.
live_smoke.blocker: No usable Docker daemon: the selected Citrini context belongs to a separate build, and the generic default Colima profile could not start because its saved disk configuration requires an unsupported shrink; see the dated project log.

known_gaps: Raw source bodies, response digests, acquisition receipts, and adapter versions are not retained, so raw-input replay is unavailable.
Source-health counters describe fetch cycles but do not separate delivery freshness from observation freshness in the API/UI.
Several adapters substitute retrieval time when provider event time is missing; this can make unknown timing look precise.
Quote history uses local polling time for collected points and is not suitable as a point-in-time market-data archive.
Retention and redistribution rights have not been reviewed across all upstream providers; fetched source content is not republished by the build.
Provider outage, rate-limit, duplicate-delivery, out-of-order completion, and clean raw-response replay behavior lack end-to-end checks.
